purpose: Fix every semantic dependency needed to implement the Step 2 executable contract without guessing, while leaving candidate/schema/validator/simulator implementation to Step 2.

numericContract.signedValue: explicit sign plus normalized magnitude only where negative values are semantically allowed
numericContract.ratio: exact numerator/denominator decimal strings or versioned fixed-point decimal string
numericContract.probability: exact decimal string or rational; never binary floating-point source of truth
numericContract.floorHpAtkCoinCostResetCount: canonical decimal strings or an explicitly versioned arbitrary-precision mantissa/exponent object

requiredUnits.time: integer milliseconds unless a field explicitly declares seconds
requiredUnits.rate: per versioned tick, second or floor; unit required in field name/schema metadata
requiredUnits.currency: integer minor gameplay unit represented by canonical decimal string
requiredUnits.probability: dimensionless exact decimal/rational in closed interval 0..1

requiredInvariants: No player-visible floor cap; 100F is a milestone and 101F+ is normal progression.
Generated tower IDs follow STABLE_ID_REGISTRY minimum-width and normalized milestone rules; alternate leading-zero canonical writes are rejected.
One reset only; Floor 1 restart; repeat same best gives zero new reset ruby.
Coin level is uncapped; evolution eligibility occurs every 100 levels; evolution never gates level continuation.
The first evolution is payable from the first effective reset free ruby without ad or payment.
N/R have deterministic routes, cover all core roles and retain measurable long-term utility.
No specific RR-UR gates core PvE, reset, evolution or required combat function.
Character and weapon gacha are separated and compatible pity carries over.
Hard pity target 100 and featured guarantee target 200 are configuration candidates tested against economy goals.
First copy is functionally complete; 20+ effective copies are optional long-term mastery with diminishing marginal value.
Paid/free ruby provenance is preserved and paid ruby does not expire.
Refund or revocation after spent paid ruby records an explicit auditable deficit/restriction under a versioned policy and never silently consumes unrelated free ledgers.
No-ad F2P covers mandatory evolution and targets one featured UR guarantee within 30-45 days.
Monthly acceleration targets about 1.5-2x and high-spend stress about 3-5x; no unbounded multiplier.
Initial ads are rewarded opt-in only, bind immutable offer catalog/version and are server-verified exactly once.
Login eligibility and grants bind immutable campaign catalog/version and server time.
All permanent economy and entitlement state is server authoritative.
Comp gacha is prohibited and odds/catalog displays match server truth.
fixturesRequired: district/cycle minimum-width boundary and milestone leading-zero rejection
first reset p50 target 20-35 minutes and repeat-best zero-ruby
evolution immediate, delayed and ordered catch-up
first-copy, practical breakpoint, 20-plus full mastery and overflow
pity at 99/100 and featured at 199/200; carryover and expired banner
refund after the affected paid ruby was already spent, explicit deficit recording and no free-ledger debit
ad duplicate callback, stale offer before start, retry after accepted offer and daily cap
login same-day multi-tab, stale campaign, retry after accepted claim, missed day and server-time rollover
guest linking conflict, deletion and raw legacy backup
large-number serialization across Node and browser
invalid ID alias write, unknown ID, malformed decimal, NaN/Infinity rejection
validatorRequirements: JSON Schema validation plus semantic cross-field validation.
Registered canonical IDs only; aliases rejected for canonical writes.
Generated tower ID formatting is unique and boundary-tested.
All probabilities are exact strings/rationals and pool sums are verified.
Wallet conservation, ledger provenance and explicit refund-deficit policy/state.
Ad and login requests require registered catalog IDs and immutable accepted versions; stale and retry behavior is fixture-tested.
State-machine reachability, terminal-state and recovery checks.
Negative fixture for every invariant and every required field family.
Fail closed when simulator, result validator, fixture, migration or workflow dependency is absent.
Reject old candidateId/schemaVersion/algorithmVersion and observed holdout reuse.
migrationRequirements: Read-only alias normalization with canonical output only.
Legacy Dawn paths merge into reset.tower_return without creating a parallel reset.
Legacy Dawn currency preserves provenance before conversion to wallet.ruby.free.reset.
Immutable raw backup and idempotent migration version marker.
Unknown or conflicting ownership fails closed into support-visible recovery.
resultRequirements: Per-scenario deterministic identity and input digest.
p50/p90/p99 progression, reset, draw and mastery metrics.
Economy conservation, refund-deficit and policy/invariant violation list.
Separate calibration and unseen holdout evidence.
Executable seal binds all source, schema, fixture, run-plan and result-validator digests.
step1Boundary: Step 1 defines meanings and dependency closure only. It does not create or execute candidate-v2, schema-v2, validator-v2, simulator-v2, result-v2 or executable seal-v2 before the committed Round 008 Step 1 PASS seal authorizes Step 2.
